title: Drift verification component
responsibilities: Execute the drift verification over the accepted decoder and normative plan/Profile schemas.
Prove that no declared table, constant, or golden can drift silently from the committed schema or contract.
state_ownership: none; the component holds no state and owns no runtime resource
concurrency: offline-single-threaded; one test process, no thread, no mutable shared state
errors: GoogleTest assertion failure on a table or golden mismatch
deployment: repository-local test process; no runtime deployment and no activation
rationale: The XCOM-XLC-001 cross-language schema is guarded where it is consumed; drift is never resolved in favour of the implementation.
